name: Dynamic MLP Maps with Hash Encoding
definition: A method for representing volumetric videos by predicting MLP parameters via 2D CNNs from axis-aligned orthogonal maps, combined with a multi-level hash encoding for spatial features, allowing real-time rendering of dynamic scenes.
summary: Dynamic MLP Maps with Hash Encoding enables real-time volumetric video rendering by combining 2D CNN-predicted MLP parameters with multi-level hash encoding, avoiding per-frame model storage.
